import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.request
import urllib.error


def run(cmd):
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)


def pct_exec(ctid, cmd):
    return run(["pct", "exec", str(ctid), "--", "sh", "-c", cmd])


def get_api_key(ctid, config_path):
    r = pct_exec(ctid, f"cat {config_path}")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"FAIL: cannot read config in container {ctid}: {r.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
        if "<ApiKey>" in line:
            key = line.split("<ApiKey>")[1].split("<")[0]
            return key
    print(f"FAIL: no ApiKey found in container {ctid} config")
    sys.exit(1)


def api_get(ctid, port, key, path):
    r = pct_exec(
        ctid,
        f"curl -s -H 'X-Api-Key: {key}' http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}",
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"FAIL: GET {path} in container {ctid}: {r.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    return r.stdout


def api_post(ctid, port, key, path, body):
    r = pct_exec(
        ctid,
        f"curl -s --fail-with-body -X POST -H 'X-Api-Key: {key}' "
        f"-H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}",
        input=body,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"FAIL: POST {path} in container {ctid}: {r.stdout} {r.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    return r.stdout


def api_put(ctid, port, key, path, body):
    r = pct_exec(
        ctid,
        f"curl -s --fail-with-body -X PUT -H 'X-Api-Key: {key}' "
        f"-H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d @- http://127.0.0.1:{port}{path}",
        input=body,
    )
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"FAIL: PUT {path} in container {ctid}: {r.stdout} {r.stderr}")
        sys.exit(1)
    return r.stdout


def main():
    password = os.environ.get("MASS_PASSWORD")
    if not password:
        print("FAIL: MASS_PASSWORD not set")
        sys.exit(1)

    # --- Step 1: prove qBittorrent login (already done in previous attempt, but re-verify) ---
    login = pct_exec(
        105,
        f"curl -s -d 'username=admin&password={password}' "
        f"http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v2/auth/login",
    )
    if login.stdout.strip() != "Ok.":
        print(f"FAIL: qBittorrent login returned: {login.stdout!r}")
        sys.exit(1)
    print("qBittorrent login: Ok.")

    # --- Step 2: update Radarr download client (id 1) with credentials ---
    radarr_key = get_api_key(103, "/var/lib/radarr/config.xml")
    radarr_dc = api_get(103, 7878, radarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/1")
    dc = json.loads(radarr_dc)

    # Set username/password in fields
    for f in dc.get("fields", []):
        if f.get("name") == "username":
            f["value"] = "admin"
        elif f.get("name") == "password":
            f["value"] = password

    # Ensure priority is valid
    if dc.get("priority", 0) < 1:
        dc["priority"] = 1

    updated = json.dumps(dc)
    api_put(103, 7878, radarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/1", updated)
    print("Radarr download client updated.")

    # --- Step 3: test Radarr download client ---
    test_result = api_post(
        103, 7878, radarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/test", updated
    )
    print(f"Radarr test result: {test_result}")

    # --- Step 4: update Sonarr download client (id 1) with credentials ---
    sonarr_key = get_api_key(104, "/var/lib/sonarr/config.xml")
    sonarr_dc = api_get(104, 8989, sonarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/1")
    dc = json.loads(sonarr_dc)

    for f in dc.get("fields", []):
        if f.get("name") == "username":
            f["value"] = "admin"
        elif f.get("name") == "password":
            f["value"] = password

    if dc.get("priority", 0) < 1:
        dc["priority"] = 1

    updated = json.dumps(dc)
    api_put(104, 8989, sonarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/1", updated)
    print("Sonarr download client updated.")

    # --- Step 5: test Sonarr download client ---
    test_result = api_post(
        104, 8989, sonarr_key, "/api/v3/downloadclient/test", updated
    )
    print(f"Sonarr test result: {test_result}")

    print("DONE: all three agree.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
